cypher:
MATCH (a:Account)
WITH count(a) AS accounts, sum(CASE WHEN a.is_blocked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS blocked_accounts
MATCH (m:Medium)
WITH accounts, blocked_accounts, count(m) AS media, sum(CASE WHEN m.is_blocked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS blocked_media
MATCH ()-[t:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->()
WITH accounts, blocked_accounts, media, blocked_media, count(t) AS transfers, sum(t.amount) AS transfer_amount
MATCH (l:Loan)
RETURN accounts, blocked_accounts, media, blocked_media, transfers, transfer_amount, count(l) AS loans, sum(l.loan_amount) AS loan_amount, sum(l.balance) AS loan_balance
LIMIT 1

MATCH (m:Medium {is_blocked: true})-[s:MEDIUM_SIGNS_IN_ACCOUNT]->(a:Account)
WITH count(DISTINCT a) AS seed_accounts, count(DISTINCT m) AS blocked_media_with_signin, count(s) AS signins_from_blocked_media,
     sum(CASE WHEN a.is_blocked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS account_rows_blocked_flagged
MATCH (m2:Medium)-[:MEDIUM_SIGNS_IN_ACCOUNT]->(anyAcct:Account)
RETURN seed_accounts, blocked_media_with_signin, signins_from_blocked_media, account_rows_blocked_flagged, count(DISTINCT anyAcct) AS all_signed_in_accounts, count(DISTINCT m2) AS all_media
LIMIT 1

MATCH (m:Medium {is_blocked: true})-[:MEDIUM_SIGNS_IN_ACCOUNT]->(a:Account)
WITH DISTINCT a
RETURN count(a) AS seed_accounts, sum(CASE WHEN a.is_blocked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS seed_accounts_also_blocked
LIMIT 1

MATCH (m:Medium {is_blocked: true})-[:MEDIUM_SIGNS_IN_ACCOUNT]->(seed:Account)
WITH DISTINCT seed
MATCH (seed)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(a1:Account)
RETURN count(DISTINCT a1) AS accounts, count(t1) AS transfer_edges, sum(t1.amount) AS amount
LIMIT 1

MATCH (m:Medium {is_blocked: true})-[:MEDIUM_SIGNS_IN_ACCOUNT]->(seed:Account)
WITH DISTINCT seed
MATCH (seed)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(a2:Account)
WHERE t2.create_time > t1.create_time
RETURN count(DISTINCT a2) AS accounts, count(t2) AS terminal_transfer_edges, sum(t2.amount) AS terminal_amount
LIMIT 1

MATCH (m:Medium {is_blocked: true})-[:MEDIUM_SIGNS_IN_ACCOUNT]->(seed:Account)
WITH DISTINCT seed
MATCH (seed)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t3:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(a3:Account)
WHERE t2.create_time > t1.create_time AND t3.create_time > t2.create_time
RETURN count(DISTINCT a3) AS accounts, count(t3) AS terminal_transfer_edges, sum(t3.amount) AS terminal_amount
LIMIT 1

MATCH (m:Medium {is_blocked: true})-[:MEDIUM_SIGNS_IN_ACCOUNT]->(seed:Account)
WITH DISTINCT seed
MATCH (seed)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT*1..3]->(r:Account)
RETURN count(DISTINCT r) AS reachable_1_to_3
LIMIT 1

CALL {
  MATCH (m:Medium {is_blocked: true})-[:MEDIUM_SIGNS_IN_ACCOUNT]->(seed:Account)
  WITH DISTINCT seed
  MATCH (seed)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(r:Account)
  RETURN r
  UNION
  MATCH (m:Medium {is_blocked: true})-[:MEDIUM_SIGNS_IN_ACCOUNT]->(seed:Account)
  WITH DISTINCT seed
  MATCH (seed)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(r:Account)
  WHERE t2.create_time > t1.create_time
  RETURN r
  UNION
  MATCH (m:Medium {is_blocked: true})-[:MEDIUM_SIGNS_IN_ACCOUNT]->(seed:Account)
  WITH DISTINCT seed
  MATCH (seed)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t3:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(r:Account)
  WHERE t2.create_time > t1.create_time AND t3.create_time > t2.create_time
  RETURN r
}
RETURN count(DISTINCT r) AS reachable_1_to_3
LIMIT 1

CALL {
  MATCH (m:Medium {is_blocked: true})-[:MEDIUM_SIGNS_IN_ACCOUNT]->(seed:Account)
  WITH DISTINCT seed
  MATCH (seed)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(r:Account)
  RETURN id(r) AS rid
  UNION
  MATCH (m:Medium {is_blocked: true})-[:MEDIUM_SIGNS_IN_ACCOUNT]->(seed:Account)
  WITH DISTINCT seed
  MATCH (seed)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(r:Account)
  WHERE t2.create_time > t1.create_time
  RETURN id(r) AS rid
  UNION
  MATCH (m:Medium {is_blocked: true})-[:MEDIUM_SIGNS_IN_ACCOUNT]->(seed:Account)
  WITH DISTINCT seed
  MATCH (seed)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t3:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(r:Account)
  WHERE t2.create_time > t1.create_time AND t3.create_time > t2.create_time
  RETURN id(r) AS rid
}
RETURN count(DISTINCT rid) AS reachable_1_to_3
LIMIT 1

CALL {
  MATCH (m:Medium {is_blocked: true})-[:MEDIUM_SIGNS_IN_ACCOUNT]->(seed:Account)
  WITH DISTINCT seed
  MATCH (seed)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(r:Account)<-[:PERSON_OWNS_ACCOUNT]-(p:Person)
  RETURN id(p) AS oid
  UNION
  MATCH (m:Medium {is_blocked: true})-[:MEDIUM_SIGNS_IN_ACCOUNT]->(seed:Account)
  WITH DISTINCT seed
  MATCH (seed)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(r:Account)<-[:PERSON_OWNS_ACCOUNT]-(p:Person)
  WHERE t2.create_time > t1.create_time
  RETURN id(p) AS oid
  UNION
  MATCH (m:Medium {is_blocked: true})-[:MEDIUM_SIGNS_IN_ACCOUNT]->(seed:Account)
  WITH DISTINCT seed
  MATCH (seed)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t3:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(r:Account)<-[:PERSON_OWNS_ACCOUNT]-(p:Person)
  WHERE t2.create_time > t1.create_time AND t3.create_time > t2.create_time
  RETURN id(p) AS oid
}
RETURN count(DISTINCT oid) AS person_owners_reachable
LIMIT 1

CALL {
  MATCH (m:Medium {is_blocked: true})-[:MEDIUM_SIGNS_IN_ACCOUNT]->(seed:Account)
  WITH DISTINCT seed
  MATCH (seed)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(r:Account)<-[:COMPANY_OWNS_ACCOUNT]-(c:Company)
  RETURN id(c) AS oid
  UNION
  MATCH (m:Medium {is_blocked: true})-[:MEDIUM_SIGNS_IN_ACCOUNT]->(seed:Account)
  WITH DISTINCT seed
  MATCH (seed)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(r:Account)<-[:COMPANY_OWNS_ACCOUNT]-(c:Company)
  WHERE t2.create_time > t1.create_time
  RETURN id(c) AS oid
  UNION
  MATCH (m:Medium {is_blocked: true})-[:MEDIUM_SIGNS_IN_ACCOUNT]->(seed:Account)
  WITH DISTINCT seed
  MATCH (seed)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t3:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(r:Account)<-[:COMPANY_OWNS_ACCOUNT]-(c:Company)
  WHERE t2.create_time > t1.create_time AND t3.create_time > t2.create_time
  RETURN id(c) AS oid
}
RETURN count(DISTINCT oid) AS company_owners_reachable
LIMIT 1

CALL {
  MATCH (m:Medium {is_blocked: true})-[:MEDIUM_SIGNS_IN_ACCOUNT]->(seed:Account)
  WITH DISTINCT seed
  MATCH (seed)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(r:Account)
  RETURN id(r) AS rid, CASE WHEN r.is_blocked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS blocked
  UNION
  MATCH (m:Medium {is_blocked: true})-[:MEDIUM_SIGNS_IN_ACCOUNT]->(seed:Account)
  WITH DISTINCT seed
  MATCH (seed)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(r:Account)
  WHERE t2.create_time > t1.create_time
  RETURN id(r) AS rid, CASE WHEN r.is_blocked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS blocked
  UNION
  MATCH (m:Medium {is_blocked: true})-[:MEDIUM_SIGNS_IN_ACCOUNT]->(seed:Account)
  WITH DISTINCT seed
  MATCH (seed)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t3:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(r:Account)
  WHERE t2.create_time > t1.create_time AND t3.create_time > t2.create_time
  RETURN id(r) AS rid, CASE WHEN r.is_blocked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS blocked
}
WITH rid, max(blocked) AS b
RETURN count(rid) AS reachable_1_to_3, sum(b) AS reachable_blocked_accounts
LIMIT 1

MATCH (a:Account)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(b:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(a)
WHERE id(b) <> id(a) AND t2.create_time > t1.create_time
RETURN count(*) AS loops, count(DISTINCT a) AS start_accounts, sum(t1.amount) AS departure_amount, sum(t2.amount) AS return_amount
LIMIT 1

MATCH (a:Account)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(b:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(c:Account)-[t3:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(a)
WHERE id(b) <> id(a) AND id(c) <> id(a) AND t2.create_time > t1.create_time AND t3.create_time > t2.create_time
RETURN count(*) AS loops, count(DISTINCT a) AS start_accounts, sum(t1.amount) AS departure_amount, sum(t3.amount) AS return_amount
LIMIT 1

MATCH (a:Account)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(b:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(c:Account)-[t3:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(d:Account)-[t4:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(a)
WHERE id(b) <> id(a) AND id(c) <> id(a) AND id(d) <> id(a) AND t2.create_time > t1.create_time AND t3.create_time > t2.create_time AND t4.create_time > t3.create_time
RETURN count(*) AS loops, count(DISTINCT a) AS start_accounts, sum(t1.amount) AS departure_amount, sum(t4.amount) AS return_amount
LIMIT 1

CALL {
MATCH (a:Account)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(b:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(a)
WHERE id(b) <> id(a) AND t2.create_time > t1.create_time
RETURN id(a) AS aid
UNION
MATCH (a:Account)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(b:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(c:Account)-[t3:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(a)
WHERE id(b) <> id(a) AND id(c) <> id(a) AND t2.create_time > t1.create_time AND t3.create_time > t2.create_time
RETURN id(a) AS aid
UNION
MATCH (a:Account)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(b:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(c:Account)-[t3:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(d:Account)-[t4:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(a)
WHERE id(b) <> id(a) AND id(c) <> id(a) AND id(d) <> id(a) AND t2.create_time > t1.create_time AND t3.create_time > t2.create_time AND t4.create_time > t3.create_time
RETURN id(a) AS aid
}
RETURN count(DISTINCT aid) AS loop_start_accounts
LIMIT 1

MATCH (l:Loan)-[d:LOAN_DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT]->(a:Account)
RETURN count(DISTINCT l) AS loans_with_deposits, count(d) AS deposit_edges, count(DISTINCT a) AS payout_accounts, sum(d.amount) AS deposit_amount, sum(CASE WHEN a.is_blocked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS blocked_payout_account_rows
LIMIT 1

MATCH (l:Loan)-[d:LOAN_DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT]->(a:Account)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(b:Account {is_blocked: true})
WHERE t1.create_time > d.create_time
RETURN count(DISTINCT l) AS loans, count(DISTINCT b) AS blocked_accounts, count(t1) AS terminal_transfer_edges, sum(t1.amount) AS terminal_amount
LIMIT 1

MATCH (l:Loan)-[d:LOAN_DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT]->(a:Account)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(b:Account {is_blocked: true})
WHERE t1.create_time > d.create_time AND t2.create_time > t1.create_time
RETURN count(DISTINCT l) AS loans, count(DISTINCT b) AS blocked_accounts, count(t2) AS terminal_transfer_edges, sum(t2.amount) AS terminal_amount
LIMIT 1

MATCH (l:Loan)-[d:LOAN_DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT]->(a:Account)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t3:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(b:Account {is_blocked: true})
WHERE t1.create_time > d.create_time AND t2.create_time > t1.create_time AND t3.create_time > t2.create_time
RETURN count(DISTINCT l) AS loans, count(DISTINCT b) AS blocked_accounts, count(t3) AS terminal_transfer_edges, sum(t3.amount) AS terminal_amount
LIMIT 1

MATCH (l:Loan)-[d:LOAN_DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT]->(a:Account)
WITH DISTINCT l, a
WHERE a.is_blocked = true
RETURN count(DISTINCT l) AS loans_paid_to_blocked_accounts, count(DISTINCT a) AS blocked_payout_accounts
LIMIT 1

CALL {
MATCH (l:Loan)-[d:LOAN_DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT]->(a:Account)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(b:Account {is_blocked: true})
WHERE t1.create_time > d.create_time
RETURN id(l) AS lid, id(b) AS bid
UNION
MATCH (l:Loan)-[d:LOAN_DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT]->(a:Account)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(b:Account {is_blocked: true})
WHERE t1.create_time > d.create_time AND t2.create_time > t1.create_time
RETURN id(l) AS lid, id(b) AS bid
UNION
MATCH (l:Loan)-[d:LOAN_DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT]->(a:Account)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t3:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(b:Account {is_blocked: true})
WHERE t1.create_time > d.create_time AND t2.create_time > t1.create_time AND t3.create_time > t2.create_time
RETURN id(l) AS lid, id(b) AS bid
}
RETURN count(DISTINCT lid) AS loans_reaching_blocked_1_to_3, count(DISTINCT bid) AS blocked_accounts_reached
LIMIT 1

MATCH (g:Person)-[:PERSON_GUARANTEES_PERSON]->(b:Person)
WITH DISTINCT id(g) AS gid, id(b) AS bid
RETURN count(*) AS pairs, count(DISTINCT gid) AS guarantors, count(DISTINCT bid) AS guaranteed_people
LIMIT 1

MATCH (g:Person)-[:PERSON_GUARANTEES_PERSON]->(:Person)-[:PERSON_GUARANTEES_PERSON]->(b:Person)
WITH DISTINCT id(g) AS gid, id(b) AS bid
RETURN count(*) AS pairs, count(DISTINCT gid) AS guarantors, count(DISTINCT bid) AS guaranteed_people
LIMIT 1

MATCH (g:Person)-[:PERSON_GUARANTEES_PERSON]->(:Person)-[:PERSON_GUARANTEES_PERSON]->(:Person)-[:PERSON_GUARANTEES_PERSON]->(b:Person)
WITH DISTINCT id(g) AS gid, id(b) AS bid
RETURN count(*) AS pairs, count(DISTINCT gid) AS guarantors, count(DISTINCT bid) AS guaranteed_people
LIMIT 1

MATCH (g:Person)-[:PERSON_GUARANTEES_PERSON]->(:Person)-[:PERSON_GUARANTEES_PERSON]->(:Person)-[:PERSON_GUARANTEES_PERSON]->(:Person)-[:PERSON_GUARANTEES_PERSON]->(b:Person)
WITH DISTINCT id(g) AS gid, id(b) AS bid
RETURN count(*) AS pairs, count(DISTINCT gid) AS guarantors, count(DISTINCT bid) AS guaranteed_people
LIMIT 1

MATCH (g:Company)-[:COMPANY_GUARANTEES_COMPANY]->(b:Company)
WITH DISTINCT id(g) AS gid, id(b) AS bid
RETURN count(*) AS pairs, count(DISTINCT gid) AS guarantors, count(DISTINCT bid) AS guaranteed_companies
LIMIT 1

MATCH (g:Company)-[:COMPANY_GUARANTEES_COMPANY]->(:Company)-[:COMPANY_GUARANTEES_COMPANY]->(b:Company)
WITH DISTINCT id(g) AS gid, id(b) AS bid
RETURN count(*) AS pairs, count(DISTINCT gid) AS guarantors, count(DISTINCT bid) AS guaranteed_companies
LIMIT 1

MATCH (g:Company)-[:COMPANY_GUARANTEES_COMPANY]->(:Company)-[:COMPANY_GUARANTEES_COMPANY]->(:Company)-[:COMPANY_GUARANTEES_COMPANY]->(b:Company)
WITH DISTINCT id(g) AS gid, id(b) AS bid
RETURN count(*) AS pairs, count(DISTINCT gid) AS guarantors, count(DISTINCT bid) AS guaranteed_companies
LIMIT 1

MATCH (g:Company)-[:COMPANY_GUARANTEES_COMPANY]->(:Company)-[:COMPANY_GUARANTEES_COMPANY]->(:Company)-[:COMPANY_GUARANTEES_COMPANY]->(:Company)-[:COMPANY_GUARANTEES_COMPANY]->(b:Company)
WITH DISTINCT id(g) AS gid, id(b) AS bid
RETURN count(*) AS pairs, count(DISTINCT gid) AS guarantors, count(DISTINCT bid) AS guaranteed_companies
LIMIT 1

CALL {
MATCH (g:Person)-[:PERSON_GUARANTEES_PERSON]->(b:Person) RETURN id(g) AS gid, id(b) AS bid
UNION
MATCH (g:Person)-[:PERSON_GUARANTEES_PERSON]->(:Person)-[:PERSON_GUARANTEES_PERSON]->(b:Person) RETURN id(g) AS gid, id(b) AS bid
UNION
MATCH (g:Person)-[:PERSON_GUARANTEES_PERSON]->(:Person)-[:PERSON_GUARANTEES_PERSON]->(:Person)-[:PERSON_GUARANTEES_PERSON]->(b:Person) RETURN id(g) AS gid, id(b) AS bid
UNION
MATCH (g:Person)-[:PERSON_GUARANTEES_PERSON]->(:Person)-[:PERSON_GUARANTEES_PERSON]->(:Person)-[:PERSON_GUARANTEES_PERSON]->(:Person)-[:PERSON_GUARANTEES_PERSON]->(b:Person) RETURN id(g) AS gid, id(b) AS bid
}
WITH DISTINCT gid,bid
RETURN count(*) AS person_pairs_1_to_4, count(DISTINCT gid) AS person_guarantors, count(DISTINCT bid) AS persons_guaranteed
LIMIT 1

CALL {
MATCH (g:Company)-[:COMPANY_GUARANTEES_COMPANY]->(b:Company) RETURN id(g) AS gid, id(b) AS bid
UNION
MATCH (g:Company)-[:COMPANY_GUARANTEES_COMPANY]->(:Company)-[:COMPANY_GUARANTEES_COMPANY]->(b:Company) RETURN id(g) AS gid, id(b) AS bid
UNION
MATCH (g:Company)-[:COMPANY_GUARANTEES_COMPANY]->(:Company)-[:COMPANY_GUARANTEES_COMPANY]->(:Company)-[:COMPANY_GUARANTEES_COMPANY]->(b:Company) RETURN id(g) AS gid, id(b) AS bid
UNION
MATCH (g:Company)-[:COMPANY_GUARANTEES_COMPANY]->(:Company)-[:COMPANY_GUARANTEES_COMPANY]->(:Company)-[:COMPANY_GUARANTEES_COMPANY]->(:Company)-[:COMPANY_GUARANTEES_COMPANY]->(b:Company) RETURN id(g) AS gid, id(b) AS bid
}
WITH DISTINCT gid,bid
RETURN count(*) AS company_pairs_1_to_4, count(DISTINCT gid) AS company_guarantors, count(DISTINCT bid) AS companies_guaranteed
LIMIT 1

MATCH (g:Person)-[:PERSON_GUARANTEES_PERSON*1..4]->(b:Person)-[:PERSON_APPLIES_LOAN]->(l:Loan)
WITH DISTINCT id(g) AS gid, id(l) AS lid, l.balance AS balance
RETURN count(*) AS guarantor_loan_pairs, count(DISTINCT gid) AS guarantors, count(DISTINCT lid) AS loans, sum(balance) AS exposure_balance
LIMIT 1

MATCH (g:Company)-[:COMPANY_GUARANTEES_COMPANY*1..4]->(b:Company)-[:COMPANY_APPLIES_LOAN]->(l:Loan)
WITH DISTINCT id(g) AS gid, id(l) AS lid, l.balance AS balance
RETURN count(*) AS guarantor_loan_pairs, count(DISTINCT gid) AS guarantors, count(DISTINCT lid) AS loans, sum(balance) AS exposure_balance
LIMIT 1

MATCH (:Person)-[:PERSON_APPLIES_LOAN]->(pl:Loan)
WITH count(DISTINCT pl) AS person_loans
MATCH (:Company)-[:COMPANY_APPLIES_LOAN]->(cl:Loan)
RETURN person_loans, count(DISTINCT cl) AS company_loans
LIMIT 1

CALL {
  MATCH (m:Medium {is_blocked: true})-[:MEDIUM_SIGNS_IN_ACCOUNT]->(seed:Account)
  WITH DISTINCT seed
  MATCH (seed)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(r:Account)
  RETURN 1 AS hop, id(r) AS rid
  UNION
  MATCH (m:Medium {is_blocked: true})-[:MEDIUM_SIGNS_IN_ACCOUNT]->(seed:Account)
  WITH DISTINCT seed
  MATCH (seed)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(r:Account)
  WHERE t2.create_time > t1.create_time
  RETURN 2 AS hop, id(r) AS rid
  UNION
  MATCH (m:Medium {is_blocked: true})-[:MEDIUM_SIGNS_IN_ACCOUNT]->(seed:Account)
  WITH DISTINCT seed
  MATCH (seed)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t3:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(r:Account)
  WHERE t2.create_time > t1.create_time AND t3.create_time > t2.create_time
  RETURN 3 AS hop, id(r) AS rid
}
WITH hop, rid
WITH hop, count(DISTINCT rid) AS accounts
RETURN hop, accounts
ORDER BY hop

CALL {
MATCH (a:Account)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(b:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(a)
WHERE id(b) <> id(a) AND t2.create_time > t1.create_time
RETURN 2 AS hops, count(*) AS loops, count(DISTINCT a) AS start_accounts, sum(t1.amount) AS departure_amount, sum(t2.amount) AS return_amount
UNION
MATCH (a:Account)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(b:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(c:Account)-[t3:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(a)
WHERE id(b) <> id(a) AND id(c) <> id(a) AND t2.create_time > t1.create_time AND t3.create_time > t2.create_time
RETURN 3 AS hops, count(*) AS loops, count(DISTINCT a) AS start_accounts, sum(t1.amount) AS departure_amount, sum(t3.amount) AS return_amount
UNION
MATCH (a:Account)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(b:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(c:Account)-[t3:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(d:Account)-[t4:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(a)
WHERE id(b) <> id(a) AND id(c) <> id(a) AND id(d) <> id(a) AND t2.create_time > t1.create_time AND t3.create_time > t2.create_time AND t4.create_time > t3.create_time
RETURN 4 AS hops, count(*) AS loops, count(DISTINCT a) AS start_accounts, sum(t1.amount) AS departure_amount, sum(t4.amount) AS return_amount
}
RETURN hops, loops, start_accounts, departure_amount, return_amount
ORDER BY hops

CALL {
MATCH (l:Loan)-[d:LOAN_DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT]->(a:Account {is_blocked: true})
RETURN 0 AS hop, count(DISTINCT l) AS loans, count(DISTINCT a) AS blocked_accounts, count(d) AS edges, sum(d.amount) AS amount
UNION
MATCH (l:Loan)-[d:LOAN_DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT]->(a:Account)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(b:Account {is_blocked: true})
WHERE t1.create_time > d.create_time
RETURN 1 AS hop, count(DISTINCT l) AS loans, count(DISTINCT b) AS blocked_accounts, count(t1) AS edges, sum(t1.amount) AS amount
UNION
MATCH (l:Loan)-[d:LOAN_DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT]->(a:Account)-[t1:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(:Account)-[t2:ACCOUNT_TRANSFERS_ACCOUNT]->(b:Account {is_blocked: true})
WHERE t1.create_time > d.create_time AND t2.create_time > t1.create_time
